_meta.confidence: HIGH = verified from sources below. MEDIUM = inferred from verified resort character. Every MEDIUM should be spot-checked before publishing.
_meta.sargassumContext: USF predicts 2026 is the worst sargassum year on record. Within Cancun: the northern tip (Playa Las Perlas, Playa Linda) facing Bahia de Mujeres is most sheltered; Punta Cancun traps sargassum against its breakwaters; the southern Hotel Zone (Km 14-25) is worst hit. Cancun already carries the destination-level seaweed flag, so this nuance belongs in each verdict, not in vibeScores.

resorts.name: Le Blanc Spa Resort Cancun
resorts.verdict: The most expensive all-inclusive in Cancun and the one most likely to justify it, built around a genuinely excellent spa and service that stays attentive without hovering. Choose it for a quiet luxury week, not for nightlife.

confidence.price: HIGH, around $900 per night for two

resorts.name: Hyatt Zilara Cancun
resorts.verdict: The safe adults-only choice in Cancun: spacious suites, six restaurants, plenty of organised activity, and a classic beachfront position without the price of the ultra-luxury tier.

confidence.beach: MEDIUM, Punta Cancun area sargassum exposure

resorts.name: Secrets The Vine Cancun
resorts.verdict: Modern, wine-led and noticeably livelier than its neighbours, with nightly entertainment and a strong food programme. Good for couples who want energy in the evening without leaving the resort.

confidence.food: HIGH, wine culture is the theme
confidence.nightlife: HIGH, DJs and karaoke, livelier than Live Aqua

resorts.name: Live Aqua Beach Resort Cancun
resorts.verdict: The calmest of the Cancun adults-only set, with a deliberately zen tone and refined rather than loud evening entertainment. Most guests are in bed after dinner, which is either the appeal or the problem.

confidence.relaxing: HIGH, sedate and zen is the documented character
confidence.nightlife: HIGH, explicitly more sedate than peers
confidence.rooms: HIGH, 371 rooms and suites, most ocean-facing

resorts.name: Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach Cancun
resorts.verdict: An all-suite resort with one of the calmest stretches of sand in the Hotel Zone, which matters more than usual in a bad sargassum year. The 40,000 square foot kids club is among the best in Cancun without the resort feeling like a theme park.

confidence.beach: HIGH, documented as calm relative to the rest of the Hotel Zone
confidence.kidsclub: HIGH, $2m 40,000 sq ft Coral KidZ Club

resorts.name: Moon Palace Cancun
resorts.verdict: The largest resort in Mexico, and it behaves like it: an enormous kids club, a wave machine, mini golf and free bikes. The catch is the beach, which is narrow, rocky and not really for swimming, so this is a pool-and-activities holiday rather than a beach one.

confidence.size: HIGH, 2,000+ rooms, 3,000+ with The Grand, largest in Mexico
confidence.beach: HIGH, documented as narrow, rocky and brownish, fine for sunbathing not swimming
confidence.kidsclub: HIGH, theater, water slide, wave machine, mini golf
confidence.easytravel: MEDIUM, south of the Hotel Zone so a longer transfer
confidence.seaweed: MEDIUM, southern exposure is the worst-hit stretch

resorts.name: Hard Rock Hotel Cancun
resorts.verdict: Loud in the way the brand promises, with strong live music and the widest spread of kids club age bands in Cancun. Families who want energy will like it; anyone listing party as a dealbreaker should look elsewhere.

confidence.kidsclub: HIGH, more age-range options than Moon Palace
confidence.familysuites: HIGH, suites for up to six
confidence.nightlife: MEDIUM-HIGH, brand character and Hotel Zone position

resorts.note: nightlife scored 3, so the engine excludes this resort for anyone selecting the 'party' dealbreaker. That is the intended behaviour.

resorts.name: Dreams Sands Cancun Resort and Spa
resorts.verdict: A mid-market family option in a walkable stretch of the Hotel Zone, without the scale or the price of the Palace properties. The best fit for families who want all-inclusive convenience but not a resort the size of a town.

confidence.overall: LOWEST of the ten, least third-party detail found; verify before publishing

resorts.name: Mondrian Cancun
resorts.verdict: The brand's first all-inclusive, opened in June 2026, with more than ten bars and restaurants and a design-hotel tone that skews social rather than restful. New enough that the service reputation is still forming.

confidence.rooms: HIGH, 400 rooms, ocean or lagoon views

resorts.note: Opened three months ago, so there is little independent review history. Flagged as the highest-risk record in this batch.
